name: swim-coach
description: Use ChatGPT as a personal swim coach with versioned adaptive cycles, direct workouts, Garmin, sync, and feedback commands.

interface.shortDescription: Plan adaptive cycles and publish swim training
interface.longDescription: Use ChatGPT as the primary interface to review swims and goals, create and approve rolling training cycles, adapt future weeks from deterministic evidence, save or edit workouts, publish them directly to Garmin, synchronize activities, and record feedback. The website remains an optional editor and status view.
defaultPrompt: Use Swim Coach to review my latest swim.
Use Swim Coach to show my swimming goal progress.
Use Swim Coach to explain why my latest swim is missing.
Use Swim Coach to adapt and save my next swim.
Use Swim Coach to publish my workout to Garmin.
Use Swim Coach to record my post-swim feedback.
Use Swim Coach to create an eight-week adaptive cycle and plan my next swim week.
Use Swim Coach to delete my planned workout everywhere.
